item.aggregated_output:
# Auto-exported by Maftools-MCP export_r_script for validation.
# This script was captured from the existing MCP tool implementation.
# MCP tool: load_tcga_data
# Underlying R/Maftools function: TCGAmutations::tcga_load
# Effective MCP parameters:
#   cancer_name = "COAD"

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(TCGAmutations))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(maftools))

maf_obj <- TCGAmutations::tcga_load(study = "COAD")

# 1) save RDS (keeps full MAF object: slots, annotations, etc.)
saveRDS(maf_obj, file = "maftools_validation_data/LLM_Stage2_validation/LLM_validation_input_file/COAD.rds")

# 2) save as .maf (write the underlying MAF data table)
maf_tbl <- maf_obj@data

write.table(
  maf_tbl,
  file = "maftools_validation_data/LLM_Stage2_validation/LLM_validation_input_file/COAD.maf",
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

item.text: The exported script writes to the same Maftools-MCP `tcga_data` paths as the MCP tool, which is useful for validating exact behavior. The preserved baseline is already copied, so I’m running the script now and then copying its regenerated files into a separate direct-R folder.
The direct R execution is still running after starting `TCGAmutations::tcga_load("COAD")`; the loader emitted only a package-version warning and the expected dataset loading message so far.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "Rscript - <<'RS'
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(data.table))
base_dir <- 'LLM_validation_outputs'
mcp_rds <- file.path(base_dir, 'mcp_preserved_outputs', 'COAD.rds')
r_rds <- file.path(base_dir, 'direct_r_outputs', 'COAD.rds')
mcp_maf <- file.path(base_dir, 'mcp_preserved_outputs', 'COAD.maf')
r_maf <- file.path(base_dir, 'direct_r_outputs', 'COAD.maf')
obj1 <- readRDS(mcp_rds)
obj2 <- readRDS(r_rds)
dt1 <- fread(mcp_maf)
dt2 <- fread(r_maf)
key_cols <- c('Hugo_Symbol','Chromosome','Start_Position','End_Position','Reference_Allele','Tumor_Seq_Allele2','Variant_Classification','Variant_Type','Tumor_Sample_Barcode')
counts <- function(obj, dt) {
  list(
    object_class = paste(class(obj), collapse = ','),
    variants_rds = nrow(obj@data),
    samples_rds = length(unique(obj@data"'$Tumor_Sample_Barcode)),
    genes_rds = length(unique(obj@data$Hugo_Symbol)),
    variants_maf = nrow(dt),
    samples_maf = uniqueN(dt$Tumor_Sample_Barcode),
    genes_maf = uniqueN(dt$Hugo_Symbol),
    columns_maf = ncol(dt),
    key_columns_present = paste(key_cols[key_cols %in% names(dt)], collapse = '"',')
  )
}
cat('MCP_COUNTS\\n')
print(counts(obj1, dt1))
cat('DIRECT_R_COUNTS\\n')
print(counts(obj2, dt2))
cat('IDENTICAL_CLASS:', identical(class(obj1), class(obj2)), '\\n')
cat('IDENTICAL_RDS_DATA_DIM:', identical(dim(obj1@data), dim(obj2@data)), '\\n')
cat('IDENTICAL_MAF_DIM:', identical(dim(dt1), dim(dt2)), '\\n')
cat('IDENTICAL_KEY_COLUMNS:', identical(key_cols %in% names(dt1), key_cols %in% names(dt2)), '\\n')
cat('IDENTICAL_WRITTEN_MAF:', identical(dt1, dt2), '\\n')
setorderv(dt1, c('Tumor_Sample_Barcode','Hugo_Symbol','Chromosome','Start_Position','End_Position'))
setorderv(dt2, c('Tumor_Sample_Barcode','Hugo_Symbol','Chromosome','Start_Position','End_Position'))
rep_cols <- key_cols[key_cols %in% intersect(names(dt1), names(dt2))]
cat('REPRESENTATIVE_MCP_ROWS\\n')
print(dt1[1:5, ..rep_cols])
cat('REPRESENTATIVE_DIRECT_R_ROWS\\n')
print(dt2[1:5, ..rep_cols])
cat('REPRESENTATIVE_ROWS_IDENTICAL:', identical(dt1[1:5, ..rep_cols], dt2[1:5, ..rep_cols]), '\\n')
cat('MCP_FILE_SIZE_BYTES:', file.info(mcp_maf)"'$size, file.info(mcp_rds)$size, '"'\\n')
cat('DIRECT_FILE_SIZE_BYTES:', file.info(r_maf)"'$size, file.info(r_rds)$size, '"'\\n')
RS"
